description: This file defines a ThemeController class for managing themes, including loading bootstrap themes, handling user preferences, CRUD themes, and system theme detection in a Superset frontend application.

classes.name: LocalStorageAdapter
classes.description: Implements ThemeStorage interface for localStorage interactions with error handling.

classes.name: ThemeController
classes.description: Main class for managing themes, including loading bootstrap themes, user preferences, CRUD themes, and system theme detection.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and callbacks.

methods.name: canSetTheme
methods.description: Returns true, indicating theme updates are always permitted.

methods.name: canSetMode
methods.description: Returns true if dark theme is available, allowing mode changes.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Returns the current global theme object.

methods.name: getThemeForContext
methods.description: Returns theme configuration for global or dashboard context, merging dashboard themes if needed.

methods.name: createDashboardThemeProvider
methods.description: Creates and caches a theme for a specific dashboard by theme ID.

methods.name: clearDashboardTheme
methods.description: Removes a cached dashboard theme by ID.

methods.name: clearAllDashboardThemes
methods.description: Clears all cached dashboard themes.

methods.name: getCurrentMode
methods.description: Returns the current theme mode.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets and applies a new theme configuration.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Sets and applies a new theme mode (light, dark, system).

methods.name: resetTheme
methods.description: Resets theme to default.

methods.name: setCrudTheme
methods.description: Fetches and sets a CRUD theme by ID for dashboard use.

methods.name: setTemporaryTheme
methods.description: Applies a temporary development theme override.

methods.name: clearLocalOverrides
methods.description: Clears all local theme overrides and CRUD themes.

methods.name: getCurrentCrudThemeId
methods.description: Returns the current CRUD theme ID.

methods.name: hasDevOverride
methods.description: Checks if a development override is active.

methods.name: getAppliedThemeId
methods.description: Returns the applied theme ID for UI purposes.

methods.name: setAppliedThemeId
methods.description: Sets the applied theme ID for UI purposes.

methods.name: canDetectOSPreference
methods.description: Returns true if OS theme detection is allowed.

methods.name: setThemeConfig
methods.description: Replaces theme configuration with provided data, typically for embedded dashboards.
